mask.description: K-D boolean Tensor, K <= N and K must be known statically.

axis.description: A 0-D int Tensor representing the axis in `tensor` to mask from. By default, axis is 0 which will mask from the first dimension. Otherwise K + axis <= N.

output.description: (N-K+1)-dimensional tensor populated by entries in `tensor` corresponding to `True` values in `mask`.
